summary_1line: Kichaka lustfully propositions Draupadi, praising her beauty and offering power, but she rebukes him, warns of her Gandharva husbands, and refuses his advances.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kichaka stands arrogantly before Draupadi in the royal hall, gazing lustfully while she faces him with stern dignity and folded arms.
Draupadi, dressed as a maid, raises a warning hand toward Kichaka while speaking of her unseen Gandharva husbands who will destroy him.
